faq: Do I lose my content during a redesign?
No. We reuse your text, images, page names and settings and only change how they look. Before we begin, we save a restore point in your site history so the old version can always be brought back.
Can you switch me from Wix to Wix Studio?
Moving between the two is a rebuild, not a toggle. We can do it as part of a redesign when you want more layout control. Say so in the order form and we confirm what it adds.
We tidy and reorder your existing text so it fits the new layout. Full copywriting is a separate job, but we mark weak or missing sections in your handover note.
Does the redesign help with SEO?
It can. A faster, clearer site helps visitors and search engines. We keep titles and addresses where they are and add redirects for anything that moves. We cannot promise rankings.
